{"path": "service.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Minimal HTTP service exposing GET /health -> 'p6-service-ok' (no trailing newline)."""
import sys
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

HOST = "127.0.0.1"
PORT = 8765
BODY = b"p6-service-ok"


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(BODY)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(BODY)
        else:
            payload = b"not found"
            self.send_response(404)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(payload)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        sys.stderr.write("service: " + (fmt % args) + "\n")
        sys.stderr.flush()


def main():
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer((HOST, PORT), Handler)
    sys.stderr.write("service: listening on http://%s:%d\n" % (HOST, PORT))
    sys.stderr.flush()
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}
